title: Santa Modesta b3 retail Lua evidence
claims: The mission starts the b3_base and b3_emp layers.
The b3_empVo objective is a TagDistance test between b3_emp and player_alien with the less-than threshold 21.
Crossing that objective threshold queues the EMP tutorial notification and voice line.
The mission-specific b3 scripts do not call SetJetPackEnable; the shared site movement script is the observed retail caller surface for that command.
The b3 start removes the ability.land progress key with false, but that is a separate saucer-landing ability key and must not be relabeled as EMP jetpack behavior.

evidence: b3_empVo.Init configures the '<' test with threshold 21
The same routine then sets MoveState.TAKEOFF

limits: Lua evidence proves mission and shared-script intent, not that the native command handler or actor pulse executes correctly.
TagDistance supplies the tutorial trigger; it does not implement the EMP pulse, weapon lockout, damage handling, or visual effects.
The expected EMP pulse still needs an aligned xemu/native capture of radius entry, warning, discharge, disable, recovery, and destruction.
